question: Tell me top10 teams with the most wins across the league
sql:
WITH wins AS (
    SELECT home_team AS team, 1 AS win
    FROM match_view
    WHERE home_team_goal > away_team_goal
    UNION ALL
    SELECT away_team AS team, 1 AS win
    FROM match_view
    WHERE away_team_goal > home_team_goal
)
SELECT team, SUM(win) AS total_wins
FROM wins
GROUP BY team
ORDER BY total_wins DESC
LIMIT 10

args.sql:
WITH wins AS (
    SELECT home_team AS team, 1 AS win
    FROM match_view
    WHERE home_team_goal > away_team_goal
    UNION ALL
    SELECT away_team AS team, 1 AS win
    FROM match_view
    WHERE away_team_goal > home_team_goal
)
SELECT team, SUM(win) AS total_wins
FROM wins
GROUP BY team
ORDER BY total_wins DESC
LIMIT 10
